title: Full index set gives the whole space
statement: Fix a prime $p$ and an integer $n$, and let $V = \bbf_p^n \times \bbf_p^n$. Taking $C$ to be the full index set $\{0,1,\dots,n-1\}$, the support submodule $V_C = \{v \in V \mid \mathrm{supp}(v) \subseteq C\}$ is all of $V$; that is, $V_C = V$.
hypotheses_covered: C taken to be the full index set (univ)
